title: Gilas Pilipinas' Asian Games debacle not the players' fault, Cone says

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Coach Tim Cone refused to pin the blame on the players who answered the call to play for Gilas Pilipinas in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 that ended in a debacle. As much as he pointed out Gilas’ failure to field the best team possible for its defense of the gold, Cone said the all-PBA crew tried to its maximum ability despite missing a quarterfinals berth. “The guys we had played their hearts out. We were just oversized by the other teams,” Cone said after Monday’s 105-61 loss to China. “But they were a great group of guys who loved […]...
